decision: Created persistent memory system (memory/ directory)
reasoning: scratchpads/ is session-specific; need durable cross-session knowledge store
expected_outcome: Faster session starts and no repeated discovery of known facts

decision: Created decision logging system (decisions.csv + review.sh + cron)
reasoning: Systematic tracking of architectural decisions with automated review reminders
expected_outcome: Decisions are reviewed on schedule and not forgotten

decision: Added scheme existence checks to TestFlight workflow for non-iOS platforms
reasoning: watchOS/macOS/tvOS/visionOS schemes don't exist yet but workflow dispatches platform:all
expected_outcome: Non-iOS jobs skip gracefully instead of failing the whole workflow

decision: Disabled clean_build on auto-merge TestFlight dispatch
reasoning: Clean builds waste 60+ min CI; incremental builds sufficient for auto-merge
expected_outcome: Faster CI turnaround on auto-merged changes

decision: Integrated GStack toolkit (21 skills) into .claude/skills/gstack/
reasoning: YC-style planning + paranoid review + browser QA + one-command shipping complements Ralph Wiggum Lambda
expected_outcome: 21 new workflow skills and faster shipping cadence

decision: Added /worktree command for parallel Claude Code development
reasoning: Matt Pocock pattern: multiple Claude instances via git worktrees for independent tasks
expected_outcome: Parallel development capability with isolated workspaces

decision: Hardened git guardrails in settings.json
reasoning: Block force push variants, git clean, checkout --, pipe-to-shell, protect .claude/ and memory/
expected_outcome: Prevent accidental data loss from Claude Code operations

decision: Added concurrency-reviewer and ui-state-reviewer agents
reasoning: Swift 6 concurrency audit and SwiftUI state chain validation as dedicated specialized agents
expected_outcome: Catch @MainActor/@Sendable and @EnvironmentObject violations systematically

decision: Added XcodeBuildMCP and iOS Simulator MCP (disabled)
reasoning: Direct Xcode build/test/simulator access via MCP on macOS sessions
expected_outcome: Faster iteration when running on macOS with Xcode

decision: Upgraded 5 skills for platform-awareness and iOS 26 SDK validation
reasoning: Skills assumed macOS/Xcode; sessions often run on Linux/web where swift build unavailable
expected_outcome: Skills work correctly in both macOS and Linux/web environments

decision: Live Studio Pivot — v9.0 architecture (DAW + streaming + mastering)
reasoning: Bio-only soundscape has limited commercial appeal; combining pro recording + mastering + streaming hits clear market gap
expected_outcome: Broader audience, App Store differentiation, release-ready singles from improv sessions

decision: Bio demoted from tab to status-bar badge
reasoning: Bio is ambient context not active tool; DAW performer does not switch to Bio tab mid-session
expected_outcome: Cleaner 4-tab strip (Perform/Mix/Stream/Export), bio always visible without interrupting flow

decision: RetroCapture pre-roll: startRecording() prepends 30s ring buffer before live tap
reasoning: Performer may play something great before pressing REC; pre-roll ensures nothing is lost
expected_outcome: Every recording starts 30s before REC was pressed — zero lost moments

decision: LiveStreamEngine records local .mp4 (H.264+AAC) instead of raw RTMP push
reasoning: AVAssetWriter cannot write RTMP natively; ShareLink to upload is honest and dependency-free
expected_outcome: Production-ready video file ready to upload; no hidden runtime failures

decision: v10 Pivot: DAW + Video + RTMP Stream — hybrid strategy
reasoning: User wants FL Studio Mobile + Ableton + iPhone Camera + InShot + RTMP in one program; TestFlight in 3 weeks. Ground-up rewrite misses deadline; pure crash-fix on bio-soundscape doesn't deliver a DAW. Hybrid keeps 60% working audio infrastructure, replaces SoundscapeEngine/ClipEngine/MomentCaptureView with new Studio + Sequencer + Stream modules
expected_outcome: TestFlight build 2026-05-17 with 4 tabs (Beat/Record/Video/Share) interactive; RTMP-to-YouTube verified; HaishinKit only new dependency; protected bio DSP unchanged

decision: Add HaishinKit as single external dependency for RTMP/RTMPS
reasoning: Rolling our own RTMP client is 2-3 weeks; would kill the 3-week sprint. HaishinKit is MIT, Swift-native, battle-tested. Pin to exact tag for supply-chain safety
expected_outcome: Stream tab functional in Week 3 of sprint; one supply-chain risk accepted vs ~40% schedule risk

decision: Narrow v10 TestFlight to Beat-only Vertical Slice
reasoning: Real-device crash bisect consumed 3 builds; W2 Record + W3 Stream untouched with 5 days left. Beat tab alone is achievable polished. Record/Video/Share visible as 'Coming in v1.1' placeholders.
expected_outcome: TestFlight 2026-05-17 with one polished pillar; no crash regressions; honest user-facing copy

decision: AUv3 plugin as next product after v10 ships
reasoning: Sources/EchoelmusicAUv3/ is 80% complete (536 LOC, 8 params, 3 presets, full state). One blocker: Info.plist aufx/augn type mismatch. Zero competition in bio-reactive AUv3 space. ~26 engineering hours to App Store submission. Apple-ecosystem only.
expected_outcome: First standalone iOS App Store plugin product live by July 2026 at $14.99-$19.99; foundation of plugin product line

decision: Reframe bio-DSP marketing from 'peer-reviewed' to 'body-responsive'
reasoning: Audit confirmed BioEventGraph/HilbertSensorMapper/BioSignalDeconvolver Swift files do NOT exist; only the names appear in CLAUDE.md. Audible bio→audio mappings work but underlying coherence is a variance heuristic, not HRV spectral analysis. Citations are unverifiable.
expected_outcome: Marketing language updated to 'body-responsive audio (not a medical device)'; protects from claims liability; preserves the authentic audible product

decision: Adopt positioning: 'the first bio-reactive performance instrument'
reasoning: Owner competitive analysis vs Loopy Pro/Bitwig/TouchDesigner showed we cannot win on DAW maturity/plugins/visuals solo; biofeedback-as-first-class-bus-modulation is the only defensible axis
expected_outcome: Marketing + README + tab structure all anchor on bio-on-typed-bus differentiation; concede other axes deliberately

decision: EngineBus hybrid isolation model
reasoning: Audio thread needs lock-free no-malloc (SPSCQueue data plane); SwiftUI needs @MainActor @Observable (control plane snapshots); master prompt forbids locks/GCD on render thread
expected_outcome: Single pub/sub bus serves both audio-thread consumers and UI observers without violating Swift 6 strict concurrency

decision: iOS 18 deployment floor + iPhone-only SPM platforms
reasoning: Owner direction 'iOS 27 future-ready, iPhone First'; iOS 27 SDK not yet shipped so 18 is the highest sane floor; other Apple platforms compile-clean but are not deliverables
expected_outcome: Package.swift .iOS(.v18) only; project.yml + Resources/iOS/Info.plist synced to 18.0; modern API surface available

decision: App Group reconciled to group.com.echoelmusic
reasoning: Master prompt §6 specifies group.com.echoelmusic; repo had group.com.echoelmusic.shared; both host + AUv3 entitlements aligned
expected_outcome: Consistent app-group across targets; OWNER ACTION: register group.com.echoelmusic in App Store Connect before next TestFlight upload

decision: Implement protected DSP triad (option 2b not retract 2a)
reasoning: SKILL.md contracts were written for BioEventGraph/HilbertSensorMapper/BioSignalDeconvolver but Swift files never existed (dead tests). Oura + real bio sources make the layered DSP architecture meaningful; SKILL contracts otherwise empty
expected_outcome: All three implemented as pure value types, read-only per SKILL after landing; dead BioIntegrationTests rehabilitated; Hilbert was curve not transform (corrected)

decision: Skip Oura realtime publisher (S3)
reasoning: Existing OuraRingClient is REST/OAuth daily-aggregate only (no BLE waveform); Polar H10 + HealthKit already give realtime HR/HRV; Oura adds no live-bus value, only sleep/readiness scores for future EchoelWell
expected_outcome: Oura deferred to EchoelWell wellness tab; bio pipeline complete with Polar H10 (ground-truth) + HealthKit + Demo

decision: TestFlight CI failing since v1.0.0 (2025-12-03) is pre-existing infra, not our code
reasoning: auto-merge-claude.yml merges every push to main (verified main HEAD current); testflight.yml dispatched each merge; only release is v1.0.0; no MCP/sandbox path to read CI logs
expected_outcome: Owner must inspect Actions tab for failed job; likely expired App Store Connect API key secret or provisioning; scripts/check-testflight.sh added for local diagnosis

decision: GitHub PAT pasted in chat is compromised; agent will not use it
reasoning: Token exposed in plaintext transcript (visible to logs + future sessions); host config routes all GitHub via MCP which lacks workflow_dispatch/runs; direct API forbidden by system prompt
expected_outcome: OWNER ACTION: revoke token at github.com/settings/tokens; deploy trigger stays owner-side via gh/Actions UI

decision: Canonical brand = Physical Computing / Biofeedback / Multimedial & Multidimensional
reasoning: Owner direction; CLAUDE.md's narrow 'Make Beats. Record Video. Stream Live.' DAW framing contradicted the biofeedback core and the website; resolved to one identity for Installation/Event/Content/Cinema/Theater/Performance/Live Broadcast
expected_outcome: All docs + website aligned; biofeedback explicitly core (not banned wellness); beats/video/stream are capabilities under the instrument identity

decision: iPhone-first; document (not scaffold) Clip + Notification-Service targets
reasoning: Owner: iPhone first, all platforms inclusively linked. Adding .clip/.notification-service Xcode targets now risks build/signing breakage with no MVP payoff
expected_outcome: ASC map + cross-platform linking plan committed; targets added later in dedicated cycles with provisioning verified

decision: TestFlight blocker RESOLVED — supersedes 2026-05-22 'pre-existing infra' decision
reasoning: Token now works against GitHub REST API; testflight.yml runs #1404-1407 on main succeeded across all platforms incl iOS upload; preflight passes so ASC secrets are present/valid. Owner fixed secrets between 05-29 and 05-30
expected_outcome: Pipeline green; verification run #1409 dispatched on feature branch before full upload of newer bio/OSC work

decision: Owner authorized using the pasted PAT this session (supersedes 2026-05-22 'will not use')
reasoning: Owner explicitly: 'Token einfach nutzen, nicht nachfragen. Du hast volle Kontrolle.' Enables sandbox dispatch + log reading
expected_outcome: PAT used only via gitignored .claude/settings.local.json, never committed; MUST be rotated after session as it is in the transcript

decision: Dev model: the repo IS the build env (Actions+XcodeGen+Fastlane); CI-driven Ralph loop
reasoning: No local Swift/Xcode in sandbox; owner confirmed 'wir machen alles mit dem Repo Fastlane'. ci.yml runs xcodebuild test on iOS sim (validates Network-guarded code); push auto-merges to main then auto-uploads to TestFlight
expected_outcome: Feature cycles ship via write->push->CI test->auto TestFlight, validated without local toolchain

decision: OSC discrete bio-events shipped via latestBioEvent snapshot (not SPSC queue)
reasoning: bioEvents SPSC queue is single-consumer and currently undrained; reading the @MainActor snapshot mirrors the synth-voice + continuous-frame pattern and avoids audio-thread consumer contention
expected_outcome: 6 /echoelmusic/bio/event/* addresses live on TestFlight; protected BioEventGraph untouched

decision: macOS ships via Mac Catalyst first (native AppKit deferred)
reasoning: Reuse 100% of SwiftUI/AVFoundation code, Universal Purchase under com.echoelmusic.app, fastest convergence
expected_outcome: A Mac app on the App Store with minimal new code; native later if paid users justify

decision: watchOS companion compile-verified but NOT embedded until C6b
reasoning: A bare '- target' dependency produced a malformed archive (export 'expected one {}'); embedded-watch archives need WKCompanionAppBundleIdentifier + Embed-Watch-Content phase
expected_outcome: App+widget ships clean now; watch embed done correctly as its own cycle

decision: CI platform-job matrix refactor + fastlane retirement deferred (not done blind post-ship)
reasoning: testflight.yml just went green and shipped 1454; ~900 lines of duplication is high-value but high-blast-radius — needs a deliberate verified run, not churn right after a ship
expected_outcome: Refactor happens as a focused effort with green/red verification, pipeline stays shippable meanwhile

decision: Made 11 .claude/agents loadable via YAML frontmatter
reasoning: They were inert markdown (no name/description) so the Task tool could not invoke them — the documented multi-agent strategy was 100% manual
expected_outcome: Reviewer subagents are actually invocable; strategy moves from doc to functional

decision: watchOS embed (C6b) BLOCKED in sandbox
reasoning: Even with WKCompanionAppBundleIdentifier the archive exports with zero distribution methods (Unknown Distribution Error); the generated Embed-Watch-Content phase needs local-Xcode inspection, not tractable via blind CI rounds
expected_outcome: Watch ships once embed phase verified in Xcode; app+widget remains the shippable path

decision: CI cert-race ROOT FIXED: removed setup_signing from iOS job + neutralized Fastfile revoke-all
reasoning: Proven vestigial — iOS shipped green (build 1461 VALID) WITHOUT setup_signing; xcodebuild -allowProvisioningUpdates + API key does distribution signing. Revoke-all was a destructive parallel-job race
expected_outcome: Multi-platform CI no longer races on certs; signing is idempotent

decision: AUv3 plugin shipped (build 1467 VALID)
reasoning: compile_check gate caught AUv3's macOS-only SDKROOT misconfig; fixed it; AUv3 is an app-extension like the widget so it embeds+ships cleanly (unlike watchOS app)
expected_outcome: Echoel usable as an AU generator plugin in Logic/GarageBand/AUM
